title: mdm-state.json
description: The mdm v2 per-user state file (~/.agents/mdm-state.json, or $XDG_STATE_HOME/mdm/state.json). Holds globally installed skills and agent definitions, the global configured-harness list, the global install mode, dismissed prompts, and experimental opt-ins. Never committed. Unknown keys are preserved across rewrites.

version.description: State format version. Version 2 adds installMode; version 1 files are read and upgraded in place.

installMode.description: How global skills and agent definitions are placed into each harness's user directory. Absent means symlink (the default).

configuredHarnesses.description: Harness names mdm installs into by default at global scope.

configuredAgents.description: Pre-release spelling of configuredHarnesses; read as a fallback and rewritten.

skills.description: Globally installed skills, keyed by name.

pluginName.description: Owning plugin, when the skill was installed via mdm plugins.

agents.description: Globally installed agent definitions, keyed by the sanitized definition name.

dismissed.description: Prompts the user chose not to see again.

experimental.description: Persisted experimental feature opt-ins (mdm experimental enable).
